Last year, Simone and I tackled a real-time analytics platform for a retail client. She designed a REST API that handled 10x the traffic of our previous system, using Python for data pipelines and Go for high-throughput endpoints. When a critical bug caused delayed reports, she debugged the issue in under an hour, rewriting a faulty Terraform module to ensure consistent environment setups. Her calm under pressure and deep understanding of AWS architecture saved us two days of downtime.  

Simone is a Senior Backend Engineer at NexaTech Consulting, where she leads backend systems for clients in fintech and healthcare. She’s the go-to person for MongoDB optimizations, having redesigned a sharded cluster that reduced query latency by over 40% without downtime. Her AWS expertise isn’t just theoretical—she mentors junior engineers on best practices and owns the architecture for NexaTech’s serverless framework.  

Beyond technical skills, Simone’s strength lies in her ability to bridge complex systems with business needs. She’s built REST APIs that scale effortlessly, often refining them based on client feedback within days. Her work ethic is unshakable; she’ll stay late to debug a CI/CD pipeline or refactor legacy code to meet modern standards.  

I’d confidently recommend Simone for any role requiring architectural vision, system reliability, and the ability to mentor others. She’s a rock-solid engineer who consistently elevates her teams.
